quests_given_text: The wiki Greenwood Forest page lists three Ambrose quests: Friendly Competition (client title 1709971177), Turning the Tables (4135591801), Digging for Glory (3896383253). Description by wording: "Ambrose needs some help if he's going to be able to compete with his arch rival Sir Wellington. Deliver this package to Sir Wellington and get his reaction." (3103689650, 2523437218) goes with the package errand; the other two have no description match. Card Duelist: Card Duelist: Confronting Ambrose (Esther sends the player, 208379763, 1796047545), Card Duelist: Something Precious (inferred). Level 20 Card Duelist is needed for his duel (client 2427999653, per Card Duelist). Pays Carson's report (526810817).

quests_given_text: The bandit book chapter: Military Intelligence, Scouting the Stompers, Searching the Hideout, Stompenmugg and likely Thugawhomp (dev titles 2-1 to 2-5); A Bandit's Life (the first title in the wiki's Greenwood Camp list; giver not stated). Receives the letters and reports in the Larkspur, Henry/Wompugg, Wugawump and Archers-on-Patrol quests (see cross-reference). Sends the player to Wompugg's mask hand-in ("Ask Glugmort at the Greenwood Camp how to handle Wompugg", 163346496). Food receiver in Glugmort's Palate and A Fancy Meal for Glugmort. After the negotiation step: "Glugmort owes [player] a favor for clearing up his ninja problem" (2798390498). Also asks for bandit work: "Defeat Bandit Patrolmen near the Greenwood Archer camp" (370784815).
